comment: cmd.c yn_function() witness for a query of QBUFSZ bytes or more (5488-5494). In debug mode a Samurai reads a blessed scroll of food detection, which grants the one-use edibility check, and eats a wished newt corpse whose name fills the 62-byte object-name limit. edibility_prompts() builds 'The corpse named ... smells foul and unfamiliar to you.  Eat it anyway?' in a BUFSZ buffer; it is longer than 127 bytes, so yn_function() logs it with paniclog() and shows it cut to 124 bytes plus '...'. 'n' declines.
